body: Maybe I can modify compose.yml in a way to skip s6 init (i don't need it, there's no real VM there) and just start hermes directly?

Confirming this on **Fly.io Machines** and adding a precise root-cause analysis, since this is blocking us (and at least one other reporter) from taking any update past `v2026.5.16`. This is the same non-PID-1 case I originally documented on the now-closed #36208 — that issue's fix only addressed the plain-Docker `sleep`/`execvp` symptom, not this one.

### Symptom (Fly Machines, also any runtime that doesn't exec the image entrypoint as PID 1)

The container crash-loops immediately and Fly gives up after 5 restarts → full outage:

```
INFO Preparing to run: `/init /opt/hermes/docker/main-wrapper.sh gateway run` as root
s6-overlay-suexec: fatal: can only run as pid 1
INFO Main child exited normally with code: 100
INFO Starting clean up.
reboot: Restarting system
machine has reached its max restart count of 5
```

### Root cause

The image entrypoint is `["/init", "/opt/hermes/docker/main-wrapper.sh"]` (s6-overlay). s6-overlay's `s6-overlay-suexec` **hard-requires being PID 1** and `fatal`s otherwise. On Fly Machines the platform's own init is PID 1 and execs the image entrypoint as a child, so `/init` is never PID 1 → instant abort. (Same applies to other wrappers: `docker run --init`, compose `init: true`, some Nomad/k8s setups.)

The contrast that makes the fix obvious — the **pre-s6 (tini) images tolerate this**, they just warn and continue:

```
Preparing to run: `/usr/bin/tini -g -- /opt/hermes/docker/entrypoint.sh gateway run` as root
[WARN  tini (655)] Tini is not running as PID 1 and isn't registered as a child subreaper.
```

### Regression window (confirmed from image metadata)

| Tag | Entrypoint | Fly result |
|---|---|---|
| `v2026.5.16` and earlier | `/usr/bin/tini -g -- … entrypoint.sh` | ✅ boots fine |
| `v2026.5.28` → `v2026.6.5` → today's `latest`/`main` (rev `57775e9e`) | `/init … main-wrapper.sh` (s6-overlay) | ❌ `can only run as pid 1`, crash-loop |

Every build from `v2026.5.28` onward is affected; **`v2026.5.16` is the last working image** and the only thing keeping our deployment alive (we're pinned to its digest).

### `HERMES_GATEWAY_NO_SUPERVISE=1` / `--no-supervise` does NOT help

That opt-out is evaluated *inside* the Python gateway. This crash is one layer earlier — at `/init` (`s6-overlay-suexec`) — which aborts before any `hermes` code runs. So there is no env-var escape hatch for non-PID-1 runtimes; pinning to a pre-2026.5.28 tag is currently the only workaround.

### Suggested fixes (in order of preference)

1. Have `main-wrapper.sh` (or a thin entrypoint shim) **detect when it is not PID 1** (`[ "$$" -ne 1 ]`) and fall back to the pre-s6 foreground path (`exec tini -- entrypoint.sh "$@"`) instead of relying on `/init`. A few lines, covers Fly/Nomad/`--init`/etc.
2. Or publish a **tini-based image variant/tag** for PaaS runtimes that wrap the entrypoint.
3. Or, at minimum, **document** that non-PID-1 platforms must pin to a tini build.

### Environment
- Fly.io Machines (Firecracker microVM), single machine, `[processes] app = "gateway run"`, no `[http_service]`.
- Broken: `latest`/`main` (rev `57775e9e`, built 2026-06-09) and every tag `v2026.5.28`+. Last good: `v2026.5.16` (rev `a91a57fa`).

Happy to test a patched image on Fly the moment one's available — this would immediately unblock us (and presumably anyone else on a non-PID-1 runtime). Thanks!

#### Summary

One PR directly addresses #38349. #43763 replaces the unconditional s6 `/init` entrypoint with PID-aware dispatch, preserving `/init` for PID 1 while using direct bootstrap in wrapped non-PID-1 runtimes.

#### Related pull requests

- #43763 `best fix` — (+114/-42) — partial fix: The diff directly targets the reported cause by routing PID-1 launches through `/init` and non-PID-1 launches through `stage2-hook.sh` plus `main-wrapper.sh`, including restoration of the s6 helper PATH required by `s6-setuidgid`. The contributor review and Fly.io report support the approach, but the maintainer-bot keep-open review identifies remaining runtime-test and documentation gaps.

#### Suggested consolidation

Keep #43763 open with a salvage path as the best existing fix: retain its dispatcher, dual-path wrapper handling, s6 PATH restoration, and container argv normalization, then update `tests/docker/test_tini_compat_shim.py`, add a wrapped-runtime `docker run --init … --help` regression alongside `tests/docker/test_smoke.py`, and revise the stale contracts in `website/docs/user-guide/docker.md` and `optional-skills/devops/hermes-s6-container-supervision/SKILL.md`. There are no competing PRs to close as duplicates.
